about_short_description.short_description: Building cmux, the open source terminal built for coding agents.

product.name: Threads
product.description: A tool that uses natural language to connect data sources, program AI agents to perform API actions, and coordinate these agents via Manasheets.

product.name: Manasheet
product.description: A table-based interface that organizes AI agents to perform sequential task steps, with rows representing task instances and columns representing agent actions.

product.name: Panels
product.description: A customizable dashboard tool that connects to databases or Manasheets to create queries and charts using natural language.

product.name: Sales Invoice PDF Extractor
product.description: A tool that extracts structured data from sales invoice PDFs into table formats for easier processing.

product.name: Sales Tagging Consumer Interviews
product.description: An AI-powered tool that tags customer interview content with categories and quotations for analysis.
